description: Backend server starts successfully and responds to health check
steps: Step 1: Start the Express server
Step 2: Send GET request to /api/health endpoint
Step 3: Verify response status is 200
Step 4: Verify response body contains status: 'ok'

description: Frontend application loads and renders without errors
steps: Step 1: Start the Vite development server
Step 2: Navigate to localhost:frontend_port in browser
Step 3: Verify the page loads without console errors
Step 4: Verify the main layout components are rendered

description: SQLite database initializes with all required tables
steps: Step 1: Start the backend server
Step 2: Check that SQLite database file is created
Step 3: Verify users table exists with correct schema
Step 4: Verify projects table exists with correct schema
Step 5: Verify conversations table exists with correct schema
Step 6: Verify messages table exists with correct schema
Step 7: Verify artifacts table exists with correct schema
Step 8: Verify shared_conversations table exists
Step 9: Verify prompt_library table exists
Step 10: Verify conversation folders table exists
Step 11: Verify usage_tracking table exists

description: New conversation can be created via API
steps: Step 1: Send POST request to /api/conversations with valid data
Step 2: Verify response status is 201
Step 3: Verify response contains conversation ID
Step 4: Verify conversation is persisted in database

description: New conversation can be created via UI
steps: Step 1: Navigate to the application
Step 2: Click 'New Chat' button in sidebar
Step 3: Verify new conversation is displayed
Step 4: Verify welcome screen or empty state is shown
Step 5: Verify input field is focused and ready for input

description: Message can be sent and received via streaming
steps: Step 1: Create or select a conversation
Step 2: Type a message in the input field
Step 3: Click send button or press enter
Step 4: Verify user message appears in chat
Step 5: Verify typing indicator is shown
Step 6: Verify response streams in word by word
Step 7: Verify complete response is displayed
Step 8: Verify message is persisted in database
